string.text: The raid window is %s h.
The Scorcher fries at full power again: the Radar antennas have spun up, the window to Limansk is closed. Whoever was late, wait for the next Cooling.
That's it, guys, the shop is shut: the Radar hums again, the psi background is back. The Cooling is over, there is no way to Limansk now.
The Cooling is over. The Brain Scorcher works as before, the raid window is closed: stay out, it will bake your brains.
The Radar antennas are at full speed again. The raid window is closed until the next Cooling.
Guys, an emission is coming! The sky turns red, the ground hums: everyone into cover, quick!
Attention everyone: an emission is coming! Drop the loot and find a roof over your head, there is little time.
An emission is coming! Whoever is out in the open, run under concrete, into a cellar, anywhere. We will talk later.
The Zone is about to blow: an emission is coming. Find cover; whoever is out in the open, don't play the hero.
The emission is over. We crawl out and count the living.
It has thundered out: the emission has passed. You can come out of cover.
That's it, the emission is over. Whoever is alive, answer. High time to walk the anomalies for fresh loot.
The emission has passed, the sky is clear. Come out of cover.
A psi storm is beginning! My head is splitting already: everyone into cover, under a roof!
Attention: a psi storm is coming! Whoever is out in the open, hide, or it will burn your brains out.
Guys, the sky is flashing: a psi storm. Into cover, quick, and don't stick your heads out until it dies down.
A psi storm is beginning, find cover! There is nothing to do outside now but go mad.
The psi storm is over. My head is still on: good enough.
It has died down: the psi storm has passed. You can come out of cover.
That's it, the psi storm is over. Whoever heard voices, it will pass. Probably.
The psi storm has thundered out, the sky has calmed. We come out.
